<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{1128u}
	Let $G$ be a finite group. Then $G$ has a normal abelian Sylow $p$-subgroup iff $|{\rm Irr}_p(G)|=0$.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- lemma-1: body_md -->

<!-- end lemma-1 -->
<!-- lemma-2: body_md -->
\label{1621y} Keep the notation above. Then $\sigma$ and $\varphi_t$ for each $t\in F^\times$ are automorphisms of the group $U$. In addition, $\sigma^{-1}\varphi_t\sigma=\varphi_{t^\tau}$ for each $t\in F^\times$.

<!-- theorem-2: body_md -->
\label{1702t} Keep the notation above. Then $|{\rm Irr}_p(G)|=2$ and  $l_p(G)= 3$.
